candidates.description: This vector activates on common proper name prefixes, capitalization patterns, and multilingual word roots.
These tokens represent Devanagari script characters containing the retroflex sibilant consonant 'ष' (ṣa) combined with various vowel signs and virama.
This vector activates for common Hindi prefixes, sub-word roots, and Devanagari character fragments.
This vector activates on Hindi verb roots, inflectional suffixes, and related morphological tokens.

These tokens represent a mixture of common Hindi linguistic suffixes or syllable clusters alongside a stray English word fragment, indicating a low-level character n-gram feature activated primarily by Devanagari text.
This feature vector activates strongly in contexts related to the sport of cricket and its associated terminology.
This feature vector activates strongly for English and Hindi words related to sports, clubs, and general nouns.
This feature vector activates on a mixed-language collection of subwords, punctuation, and unrelated linguistic fragments without a single cohesive semantic theme.
This vector represents morphological variations and suffixes related to the action and actors of running.
This vector is related to multilingual subword tokens and fragments representing Hindi script characters and Latin letter combinations.
